title: Health oscillation attenuator and circuit simulator for multi-region failover stability
creator: Ava Chen
description: Reduce autoscaler thrash and prevent cascade failovers by introducing a health-signal attenuator (temporal smoothing + amplitude damping) and a deterministic circuit simulator harness to validate multi-region failover and circuit-breaker interactions under realistic token-weighted traffic mixes.
acceptance_criteria: Attenuator implemented as library used by readiness/liveness aggregator with config knobs: window, damping factor, token-weight weighting
Circuit simulator can run region-level scenarios (partial outage, latency spike, DNS flapping) and produce deterministic metrics reproducing past incidents
Autoscaler integrations include derate handshake (canary pause) to prevent immediate scaling actions during transient health oscillations
No regressions in per-route p90 latency for synthetic workload (<+5% from baseline) and reduced autoscaler scale-down thrash in chaos tests by >=60%
Dashboard panels added to Console showing attenuated vs raw health signals, attenuator config, and simulator runbook outputs
implementation_notes: Add Attenuator component in health-aggregation path: computes exponential moving average (alpha configurable) then applies amplitude damping factor that scales down binary failures from intermittent checks
Token-weighted averaging: health samples are weighted by token-cost metric to avoid low-cost p99 workloads forcing region-wide decisions
Introduce hysteresis windows: short-window for detection (30s), medium-window for decisioning (3m), cooldown window for rollback (10m)
Autoscaler handshake: on detection of health-oscillation pattern, autoscaler enters DERATE state where only safe incremental scaling allowed and scale-to-zero suppressed for configured interval

Circuit Simulator harness (cluster-sim): deterministic failure injection (latency, partial CPU starvation, probe flapping), replay historical traffic traces from 2025 incidents, export JSON run artifacts for audit
Expose attenuator metrics: raw_probe_rate, attenuated_probe_score, damping_events, oscillation_detected, derate_engaged
Config stored as feature-flagged config in control plane with per-customer overrides for Dedicated/Private customers
rollout_plan: 1) Merge library behind feature flag and unit tests + CI
2) Run circuit-sim scenarios in staging with production traffic replay (2 days)
3) Canary enable attenuator for low-traffic region (eu-west-1) for 48h with aggressive telemetry
4) If pass, expand to 30% of regions over 72h with autoscaler DERATE enabled
5) Full global rollout with opt-out control and documentation
risks: Over-smoothing could hide real degradations and violate SLOs if misconfigured
Incorrect token-weighting may bias signals away from user-visible failures
Simulator assumptions might diverge from production failure modes leading to false confidence
Feature flags misapplied to Dedicated customers could cause configuration drift
